lines.speaker: Deacon
lines.text: Sully said you would come. The pier crew already knows your face.

lines.speaker: Deacon
lines.text: Keep your head down, find the marked car, and do not bring the heat home.

lines.speaker: Sully
lines.text: You crossed the harbor with half the city looking for you. That takes nerve.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: It takes a place to sleep. We square?

lines.speaker: Sully
lines.text: For tonight. Welcome to the Narrows.
